class MockHandler(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        # Extract path
        path = self.path
        
        # Match UniProt accession
        # e.g., /uniprotkb/P12345.json or /uniprotkb/P12345.fasta
        match_json = re.search(r'/uniprotkb/([A-Z0-9]+)\.json', path)
        match_fasta = re.search(r'/uniprotkb/([A-Z0-9]+)\.fasta', path)
        match_txt = re.search(r'/uniprotkb/([A-Z0-9]+)\.txt', path)
        
        if match_json:
            acc = match_json.group(1)
            self.serve_json(acc)
        elif match_fasta:
            acc = match_fasta.group(1)
            self.serve_fasta(acc)
        elif match_txt:
            acc = match_txt.group(1)
            self.serve_txt(acc)
        else:
            self.send_response(404)
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(b'{"error": "Not found"}')
